serviceModel: self-hosted pay-per-request proxy for Brave Search API
network: Base mainnet (x402); Base Sepolia testnet also documented

sequence: payment authorization is verified without moving funds
x402 settlement occurs only after successful search
paid response returns settlement receipt/transaction reference
paymentSemantics.economicImplication: A failed search may have zero settled provider cost under this execution model. Outcome Economics must distinguish payment authorization/verification from settlement and record settlement timing/failure charging semantics when calculating effective cost per acceptable result.

comparisonBoundary: bx402 is an experimental/self-hosted proxy rather than an observed public James-callable provider endpoint, so it is competitor/payment-semantics evidence only and must not enter provider ranking.

observations: x402 and MPP micropayment proxy for Brave Search
Both rails charge 5000 base units = US$0.005 of a six-decimal token
x402 mainnet support is Base USDC
x402 verifies without moving funds, runs search, then settles; failed search is not charged

requiredBenchmarkChange: Persist settlement_state/timing and charged_failure semantics separately from attempt count so cost-per-acceptable-result uses actual settled spend, while failed attempts still remain visible as reliability evidence.
